company.name: Inertia
company.shortDescription: Inertia is a fusion-energy company that builds and generates commercialized fusion powers.
company.description: Inertia is a commercial fusion energy company focused on laser-based fusion, grounded in proven physics, and aiming to deliver clean, limitless power. The company plans to innovate within the fusion sector, reinforcing its goal of commercializing fusion energy within the next decade.

productsAndServices.description: A 10 MJ, diode-pumped solid-state laser system designed to deliver approximately 1,000 beamlines at a 10 Hz repetition rate for inertial-confinement fusion power generation.
productsAndServices.name: Inertia Modular Fusion Laser System

productsAndServices.description: Factory-produced inertial-fusion fuel targets containing a hohlraum, carbon shell, deuterium-tritium fuel, and supporting films, designed for high-rate laser fusion shots at a target cost below $1.
productsAndServices.name: Mass-Manufactured Fusion Fuel Targets

productsAndServices.description: A planned grid-scale fusion power plant that uses high-energy lasers to ignite deuterium-tritium targets and convert fusion heat into dispatchable electricity and industrial process heat.
productsAndServices.name: Laser Inertial Fusion Energy Power Plant
